\caption{The pricing-door rows the main text does not carry: the capacity door with
$\delta$ applied to every sector, and both doors under mobile labour with the CPI
numeraire. Conventions as in Table~\ref{tab:pricing-door}. Under the all-sector
profile the sign of the deflator response looks like a property of the financing
closure --- a fall only under external finance ($-0.82$ percent,
\texttt{pricing\_capacity-v2-GAMMA-F3-dm05}), against a fall in all three columns
when $\delta$ is confined to the goods sectors --- because it is the service sectors,
which receive none of the programme directly, that lose demand and productivity under
reallocation. The sign is therefore a statement about where returns are assumed to
live. Generated from the same run manifests; no number is hand-typed.}
